issues.what: Verify command will not produce useful output on K8s 1.29+
issues.detail: The verify command `kubectl -n kube-system get pod kube-controller-manager-<node> -o yaml | grep eviction` greps for 'eviction' in the kube-controller-manager pod spec. The `--pod-eviction-timeout` flag was removed in Kubernetes 1.27, so on K8s 1.29+ clusters this grep returns nothing. The explanation correctly documents the deprecation and modern mechanism (NoExecute taints + tolerationSeconds), but the verify command does not match the current behavior.
issues.fix: Change verify to: `kubectl get pod -n kube-system -l component=kube-controller-manager -o yaml | grep -E 'node-monitor|taint'` or set verify to null since the flag no longer exists in K8s 1.29+.
